Name: Horse Skins - Customize Your Horse
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=6][b][i][color=#ff7700][u][center]Horses Variety[/center][/u][/color][/i][/b][/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=5][u][b][i]NOTE:[/i][/b][/u][/size][/color]
[b][color=#00ff00][size=4]The Special Horses come from the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1421]Better Horses[/url]" By [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5005122]SerialDollface[/url], compiled and brought to you in an easier to use Content Patcher Version. [/size][size=4]There are also some additions on my part.
﻿[/size][/color][/b][size=4][b][color=#00ff00]The Normal Horses were made from the animation redesign done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/31773660]avalitor[/url] in the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261]Redesigned Horse Running Animation[/url]". Enjoy![/color]

[/b][/size]

[color=#00ffff][b][size=5][u][i]Other Variety Family Mods:[/i][/u][/size]
[size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10574]Cats Variety[/url][/size][/b][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10575][size=4]
Dogs Variety
[/size][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8914][size=4]Mines Variety
[/size][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8890][size=4]Monsters Variety
[/size][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14187/][size=4]Nature Variety
[/size][/url][color=#ff00ff][size=6][b][u]
[/u][/b][/size][/color][size=4]This mod allows you to change the appearance of your horse, eyes color, hair color, to fit saddles and RGB shadow.
Great variety of combinations that you will be able to make.[/size]

[size=5][b]
[i][color=#ff00ff][u]This mod has two categories:[/u][/color][/i]
[color=#f4f4f4][i]Normal Horses[/i] can be modified. 
[i]Special Horses[/i] are already modified and cannot be changed.[/color][/b][/size]

[color=#ffff00][b]
[i][size=5][u]Mod Options:[/u][/size][/i][/b][/color][color=#ff7700] 
[/color][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]I recommend using the Mod: "[/b][/size][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]". To read what each option does from this menu[/b][/size][/color][size=6]
[/size]
[b]
[color=#ff0000][size=5]Some options have the variable "Random" which allows you to change the object placed on your cat automatically every day.[/size][/color][/b][/font]

Downloads.Description:
REMOVE THE PREVIOUS VERSION BEFORE INSTALLING THIS VERSION.
Unzip and move to the mods folder of the game. I recommend using Generic Mod Menu to configure the mod.
